title: Repair the evidenced nonprod readiness failure without bypassing gates
summary: Diagnosed terminal failure in Actions run 37006617043 during nonprod dev VM deployment. Bound the failing check to verify_exact_component_deployment in scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh where paper-signal-producer was reported unhealthy. Identified root cause: services/control-plane/governance/deployment_plan.py _normalize_lineage copied Registry null Lineage fields into promoted artifact metadata, violating promoted_artifact_metadata.schema.json (which types lineage.source_dataset_refs as an array). Read-only VM evidence proved binding rb-30092281 created 2026-10-02 by current dev carried source_dataset_refs=null alongside 8 earlier bindings. Fixed source defect in deployment_plan.py to omit null lineage fields. Added regression test_projection_omits_null_registry_lineage_fields in test_deployment_plan.py, alongside paper_signal_producer health and recovery regressions in test_deploy_nonprod_vm.py. Retained coordinator runbook for Human/Ops to retire existing null-lineage bindings on dev VM.

inspected_run.failing_step: Deploy dev VM stack under lease
inspected_run.terminal_error: [remote-deploy] required component(s) unhealthy or unknown: paper-signal-producer: health=unhealthy
inspected_run.compensation_action: Sealed exact-artifact BFF restore succeeded and verified, safely reverting to prior baseline without activating candidate pair.

root_cause_analysis.mechanism: paper-signal-producer discovered 9 active paper bindings from runtime-manager (including rb-30092281 created 2026-10-02 02:35 by dev 67118cb23). Each binding failed artifact loading with: 'Metadata schema validation failed at lineage.source_dataset_refs: None is not of type array'. The schema services/registry/lineage/promoted_artifact_metadata.schema.json requires lineage.source_dataset_refs to be an array, rejecting null. All 9 bindings degraded, setting health status to 'degraded'. check_worker_health in services/worker_health.py failed (exit 1) because status != 'ok', marking the container unhealthy.
root_cause_analysis.source_defect: services/control-plane/governance/deployment_plan.py _normalize_lineage copied Registry null Lineage fields into promoted artifact metadata. The Registry API serializes absent Lineage fields as null, whereas promoted_artifact_metadata.schema.json types them as arrays/strings.
root_cause_analysis.source_fix: In deployment_plan.py _normalize_lineage, omit null lineage fields as Lineage.to_dict() does: normalized = {key: value for key, value in lineage.items() if value is not None}.
root_cause_analysis.classification: Source defect with hosted state impact. Control plane projection copied null lineage fields into artifact metadata; existing bindings on dev VM retained null fields.

disproven_hypotheses.disproof: Transient polling checks during scripts/openclaw-configure-shared-model-pool.sh while the gateway restarted after model-pool configuration. Both openclaw-gateway (port 18789) and openclaw-gateway-adapter (port 18104) were healthy (Up and healthy) prior to post-up verification gates.

disproven_hypotheses.disproof: source-ingest was healthy and returned HTTP 200 OK for /api/source-ingest/snapshots/latest?symbol=SPY across all requests in run 37006617043.

disproven_hypotheses.observation: Hosted-only legacy data without source defect
disproven_hypotheses.disproof: Read-only VM evidence confirms runtime binding rb-30092281 (persona-ae7b97a96e92acd86682) was created 2026-10-02 02:35 by current dev 67118cb23 and also has lineage.source_dataset_refs=null, proving current code actively propagated the defect on new bindings.

isolated_reproduction.reproduced_error: Metadata schema validation failed at lineage.source_dataset_refs: None is not of type 'array'

guarantees: Execution projection omits null registry lineage fields so emitted promoted artifact metadata strictly satisfies promoted_artifact_metadata.schema.json.
Unhealthy paper-signal-producer immediately fails closed, records verification failure in backend-components-receipt.json, and triggers compensation restore rather than activating candidate pair.
Healthy paper-signal-producer passes gate, produces verified backend components receipt with status=passed and all_passed=true, admitting candidate pair.
Degraded binding caching and supported recovery procedures are substantiated and proven by exercising production main(), write_health(), and healthcheck().

coordinator_action_required.action: Retire or clean up the 9 existing paper bindings on the dev VM via runtime-manager API (/api/runtime-bindings/<binding_id>/retire) or database cleanup, followed by paper-signal-producer container restart (or activating at least one valid active paper binding) so paper-signal-producer initializes/recovers with status: ok.
coordinator_action_required.boundary: Source fix and regression coverage are delivered via PR #6097. Hosted cleanup of existing bindings in the database and the redeploy are performed by the Human/Ops coordinator. Workers have no SSH or VM access.
